name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and reach the dumbbells toward the floor while your free leg extends behind you.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstring, with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, then repeat before switching legs.
image_prompt_scene: Standing on one leg holding dumbbells in front of the thighs.
